verdict.rationale: Bridge's orchestration API (part of the Stripe crypto stack) is documented to programmatically support on-ramps, off-ramps, and crypto-to-crypto flows. Stripe also performs implicit fiat↔stablecoin conversion: stablecoin payments settle as fiat, payout conversion is handled for Connect, and a customer-facing onramp exists. None of these is shown as a first-class quote-and-execute conversion API with documented terms. Missing for 10: an explicit quotes endpoint, documented conversion rates/spreads, documented conversion fees, documented settlement times, and evidence of stablecoin-to-stablecoin conversion details beyond a one-line mention.
